scope: Available-window hourly surface-RHi sample support; not independently observed snow or full-paper reproduction
source_level: existing author-calibrated export reused; not new remote download or raw logger
time_policy: Original printed labels retained; +1h decimal discrepancy is not repaired or declared UTC offset. No cross-logger join.
surface_RH_channel: Surf_RHIce, zero-based column6, percent relative to ice; separate from Campbell air RH
paper_rule_source: McKay2026 DOI10.1017/S0954102025100448; Variation in snow days and Fig6
equivalent_day_qualification: Count-based hourly-sample equivalent only; not integrated continuous snow-cover duration. The paper48-samples/day divisor is not applied to hourly records.
cannot_compare_directly_reason: November2009 and December1-9 absent; hourly author export differs from paper30min surface series; version/resampling and timing provenance not recovered. No missing days set to zero or extrapolated.
